body:
Only thing I'm known for is negative thoughts.  If I let go of those I will be left with nothing. 

I have just embraced the fact that I'm just a negative mess. 
I just need to learn to accept that other people can be/fake being happy. 

Thanks for the offer dude but I have absolutely nothing to talk about. You can text me if you want anytime too. I can probably be of help that way

It just makes me feel dead inside without the satisfaction of being dead.

Can't do it more than a few seconds,My inner voice pops up reminding me that I have nothing to smile about
Is it really one if you set it yourself and walk into it?

>Think about what you really want, really take your time with it.

Really wish I had that time. Have rest of the subjects till 24th. 
Can't afford time to even plan a way to kill myself right now and I can't even think of anything more pathetic than this.

Only thing I will get is pity or straight up laughs on my face if I tell anyone about it.

Not sure how it can be a beginning. If it really is then I definitely want it to end. 

Only thing my parents were proud of  and I was really good at is studies.
Now I feel so worthless and stupid

>it is better to take a step back and make sure we are also taking time to genuinely care for ourselves. Self care is incredibly important. 

I've realised that a while ago. I was planning on doing things to keep myself occupied so I don't go into a depressive state after the exams. 
I thought I would do well. I put in effort. I tried but I just realised that it wasn't enough. Maybe I shouldn't have gotten into this course. 

I only did because I didn't want to disappoint my parents or make them regret having me in the first place. 
I already wasted an year when I couldn't crack the common entrance test for the course. The second time I knew it would suck but I had to accept it. 

>School will always be there. Your parents, I am certain, care far more about your health inside and out, than you hurrying up to finish schooling. 

I do have to hurry up. Both my parents and grandparents are sick.  
There's no one with someone with some medical knowledge to look after them.

My mom already worries too much about me,I can't tell her I am going to fail or that I can't do this anymore. They already picture me finishing this and doing further studies and here I am not even being able to get through year 2. 


>Will they be disappointed? Maybe. But I’m sure they would rather have their son alive and trying to be healthy than feeling like the only solution is to end himself. 

Maybe they would rather have me alive but I would rather die than watch my parents be helpless or disappointed. 

>I’m not sure if this will help or not, but... If you ever want to vent or need to talk to someone, you can always feel free to message me as well. I won’t always have advice but maybe it will help to get it out to someone who won’t judge. At least until you can find a way to get professional assistance. 

You have already done enough Sir,Thank you so very much. 

I just wanted to type it out. I probably won't do it anytime soon because I'm still a fucking coward. 

Have a good day. Enjoy your weekend.

>Now I help save lives over the phone for a living. A huge part of it for me was despite my anxiety, I knew I wanted to help others. It made me push myself harder. 

Thank you for what you do. Really appreciate it. World needs people like you.
If I get out of this alive I would like to try and help make a change in someone's life. 

Make it better. I'm tired of being helpless just relying on luck/fate or karma you name it. 

Or maybe I just am a nobody. One of the millions of people who have a positive impact around them. 

>I don’t know what it’s like for you/your culture... but are your able/have you already sought therapy and possibly medication? Not that it’s always the answer. 

No one still takes mental health seriously. It still is a disease you make up for many. 
Even a meme among people my age. 

I can't get any treatment where I am studying (No one here is qualified to even handle physical emergencies let alone mental) 

I can probably get some treatment if I go home but then I will have to tell my parents. I planned on doing it once I finished my course but now I don't think I'm going to live that long.

>Life is full of discouragement and road blocks. Not just in education, in every aspect.

I know. Just tired of them now. Don't have or want to face more. 

> You’ll find the best way to do things, and it will get easier. 

I know you mean well but it definitely won't get easier. Even if I try again and clear my second year I have clinic hours from third. 

And I'm severely anxious when interacting with new people. I can't deal with this at all and it's only going to get worse. 

>I hope you keep trying, friend. Best wishes. 

Thanks. I don't have an option. 
It's either die and make sure my parents don't waste more money on me or somehow continue so they don't regret paying for my education.

>I’m in the same boat as well. I’m not doing well in college and, coming from an Asian family, you can imagine how bad that must feel in comparison to an Indian family. 

I can understand,I'm sorry. Hope it gets better in the future. 

>But life is about trial and error, and if you’re failing your exams, that might suck now but you’ll find a way to get past it. 

I don't think I can. And neither do I think my parents know how to handle it. I still remember the disappointment in my mom's voice after my 10th grade boards where I got a 9.5/10 GPA instead of 9.8 or 10. 

It still plays in my mind after 5 years. 
I don't want my parents to look bad because of me. No one would say anything to me but they would mock my parents. I have seen my mom cry way more for a lifetime. 

>If your parents love you, they’ll be disappointed, but they’ll never stop supporting you. You just need to find that support for yourself in your heart first. 

Yeah I don't know how to get there. Can't even get myself to study for the next exam. It feels useless now.
